headline: Strong Topline Beat; Margins Under Pressure

highlights: On a consolidated basis, revenue grew 36% YoY (24% on a like-to-like basis), 13% ahead of our estimate, despite external headwinds including the West Asia tensions, floods in Nepal, persistent commodity inflation, and deficient rainfall in parts of the country.  The domestic business grew 49% YoY (32% like-to-like) with volume growth of 43% (26% like-to-like).

We maintain our HOLD rating on the stock. 2QFY27 performance update: Consolidated revenue stood at Rs10.88bn (+36.2% YoY), 13% ahead of our estimate, aided by domestic volume growth of 43% YoY (26% like-to-like).

Gross margin contracted by 520bps YoY to 65.8% due to elevated input costs and the mix impact of acquired businesses, partly offset by lower staff costs (-230bps YoY) and other expenses (-120bps YoY).
EBITDA grew 24.5% YoY to Rs2.22bn (18.5% ahead of our estimate), with margin at 20.4% (down ~190bps YoY).
valuation: The strategic investments portfolio grew 73% on a like-to-like basis and now contributes 26% of domestic business, while organised channels contribute 37% of domestic sales.  We now value the stock at 19x Sep-28E EPS (20x Jun-28E earlier), a ~28% discount to its 5-year average P/E of 26.5x, arriving at a revised target price of Rs435 (Rs445 earlier).
We roll forward our valuation and now value the stock at 19x Sep-28E EPS arriving at a revised TP of Rs435 (Rs445 earlier).
We maintain our HOLD rating on the stock, implying a 12% upside from the CMP of Rs388.
